confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sicilian and southern Italian price levels, with no live listings checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July demand is seasonal and room rates vary widely. The FX observation comes from a search result attributing the figure to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview; I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional comparables in southern Italy and Sicily (Naples, Catania), somewhat below Rome and Milan at ordinary venues, with July summer accommodation pricing.
